title: Which date gives the answer 1390?
description: Ruhee follows the date trick with a new date and reports one thousand three hundred ninety. One hundred sixty five is taken away, the date is read from the digits, and the trick is run forward to check it. Keeko doubts that the month is thirteen and the day is ninety.
teaching_notes: One idea: take away the fixed number first, then read the day from the last two digits and the month from the digits before them. Watch for students who split the reported number itself into a month and a day.

source: Mukta reports 1390. Which date did she think of? Check by ru
video_script.why: A child finds the date from a reported answer by taking away the fixed number, then checks it by running the trick forward.
video_script.substitution: the book's own second date, with the reported answer one thousand three hundred ninety
video_script.anchor: the date trick card and the reported answer 1390
video_script.wrong_answer: the month is thirteen and the day is ninety
video_script.wrong_move: splits the reported number itself into a month and a day, without taking the fixed 165 away first
video_script.payoff_line: Taking away one hundred sixty five shows the date is the twenty fifth of December.

names.Ruhee: the friend who thinks of a date and reports the answer

maths_rules: The last two digits are the day, 25, and the digits before them are the month, 12.
video_script.design: One idea: take away the fixed number, then read the date. The reported answer stays in the anchor band and the forward check sits under the reading on the working board.

beats.on_screen: the small title card From your book appears; Ruhee holds a slip with the answer 1390; the question is written in the anchor band

marks.book: the small title card From your book appears
marks.slip: Ruhee holds up a slip with 1390
marks.ask: the words which date? are written

narration: <bookmark mark='book'/>This question is from your book. Ruhee thinks of another date and follows the same six steps.
<bookmark mark='slip'/>The answer reported is one thousand three hundred ninety.
<bookmark mark='ask'/>Which date did Ruhee start with?

beats.on_screen: the slip 1390 holds still and the words which date? glow

marks.think: Keeko sits at the corner of the board

narration: <bookmark mark='think'/>Think and tell.

beats.on_screen: the line 100M + 165 + D with M labelled month and D labelled day

marks.names: M is labelled month and D is labelled day

narration: <bookmark mark='line'/>The six steps always make the answer one hundred em plus one hundred sixty five plus dee.
<bookmark mark='names'/>Here em is the month and dee is the day.

beats.on_screen: Given: the answer 1390 after the six steps
narration: <bookmark mark='given'/>Given, Ruhee reports one thousand three hundred ninety after the same six steps.

beats.on_screen: To find: the date, and a check by running the trick forward

marks.find: the things to find are written

narration: <bookmark mark='find'/>We have to find the date, and then check it by running the trick forward.
<bookmark mark='take'/>Step one, take away one hundred sixty five from one thousand three hundred ninety.
<bookmark mark='form'/>That leaves one thousand two hundred twenty five, which is one hundred em plus dee.

beats.on_screen: 1225: the last two digits 25 are the day D; the digits before them, 12, are the month M

marks.day: the last two digits 25 are boxed as D
marks.month: the digits 12 before them are boxed as M

narration: <bookmark mark='day'/>Step two, the last two digits are the day, which is twenty five.
<bookmark mark='month'/>The digits before them give the month, which is twelve.
<bookmark mark='first'/>Step three, run the trick forward with month twelve. Twelve times five is sixty, and sixty plus six is sixty six.
<bookmark mark='second'/>Sixty six times four is two hundred sixty four, and adding nine gives two hundred seventy three.
<bookmark mark='third'/>Two hundred seventy three times five is one thousand three hundred sixty five. Adding the day twenty five gives one thousand three hundred ninety, which matches.
<bookmark mark='ans'/>Taking away one hundred sixty five shows the date is the twenty fifth of December.
<bookmark mark='hand'/>Keeko has raised a hand. Let us check the doubt and solve it.

beats.on_screen: Keeko's bubble shows 13 | 90 split off the slip 1390; a calendar strip shows months 1 to 12 with no 13; the boxed 165 flashes; the bubble is struck out

marks.doubt: Keeko's bubble shows 13 | 90 split off the slip
marks.months: a calendar strip shows months 1 to 12 with no 13
marks.strike: the boxed 165 flashes and the bubble is struck out

narration: <bookmark mark='doubt'/>Keeko thinks the month is thirteen and the day is ninety, reading straight off the slip.
<bookmark mark='months'/>A year has no thirteenth month, and no month has ninety days.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>The fixed one hundred sixty five is still inside the number.
